lines.zh: 我张着嘴，慢慢往前推水。
lines.en: Mouth open, I push slowly through the water.

lines.zh: 我这一身比你的船还长。
lines.en: I am longer than your little boat.
Cold water slides along my back.
One sweep of my tail moves the sea.
I cruise through the deep blue dark.

lines.zh: 浮游的东西都进我嘴里。
lines.en: Everything drifting ends in my mouth.
I glide beneath the ice sheet.
I do not chase; the water brings food.
My dorsal fin cuts a white line.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉到更冷的水里。
lines.en: I sink slowly into colder water.
I hang still and let water pass my gills.

lines.zh: 这一口滤不出什么味道。
lines.en: This mouthful tastes of nothing.
The light under the ice is faint.

lines.zh: 我在等浮游的东西聚过来。
lines.en: I wait for the drifting things to gather.
I cannot close my mouth at all.
Down deep there is no sound.
I turn in a wide, slow arc.

lines.zh: 一群小虾从我嘴边过去。
lines.en: A swarm of krill drifts past my lips.
Fine sand settles on my hide.
The cold keeps me wide awake.
Filter-feeding with my mouth open all day.
Old scars line my back.
The seafloor lies far below me.
I do not feel like doing anything.

lines.zh: 浮游的东西一小口，不够塞牙。
lines.en: One mouthful of plankton, not even a bite.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰层下，像一块礁。
lines.en: I hang beneath the ice like a reef.
You look small beside my mouth.
I see you standing on the ice.
Are you one of the drifting things?

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，把你和浮游生物一起滤进来。
lines.en: Mouth open, I filter you in with the plankton.
Your boat is shorter than I am.
I lift an eye and study you.
You look blurred through the water.
You knock the hull; I hear it.
I am not hungry, only curious.

lines.zh: 你不动，我这张嘴也不动。
lines.en: Stay still, and this mouth stays still.
Does my open mouth frighten you?

lines.zh: 冷海里，从没有你这种味道。
lines.en: The cold sea never smelled anything like you.
Who dares take a bite out of me?

lines.zh: 这一下在我背上留了痕。
lines.en: That one left a mark on my back.
My hide is thick, but it still hurts.
Blood draws a long line in the water.

lines.zh: 疼从背鳍传开，我慢慢沉。
lines.en: Pain spreads from my dorsal fin, so I sink.

lines.zh: 杀了我，你只得一块鱼排。
lines.en: Kill me and you get just one fish steak.
I sink lower to get away.
It bit me near the gills.
That bite made me furious.
I turn to find whatever bit me.
What you scatter is far too small.
One gulp would take your whole net.
This is not enough for one mouthful.
I do not chase food; I wait.
Scatter the bait on the surface.
I open wide and drift closer.
The taste is too faint to notice.
Do not put your hand near my mouth.
Big as I am, I eat very little.
Let the water bring the food to me.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张着，只是想滤食。
lines.en: My mouth is open only to filter the water.
My hide is thick; that did not hurt.
I shift aside and the water churns.
Your boat scraped along my back.
I am too big to dodge.
I move slowly; give me room.
My tail fin caught you.
Do not swim so close to me.
This bulk does not yield easily.
After the bump I keep going.
In this cold sea, partners are rare.
I follow that larger shadow.
Side by side we filter the same water.
She is slower; I wait for her.

lines.zh: 两条大影子贴着冰下走。
lines.en: Two huge shadows glide under the ice.
I neither fight her nor drive her off.
In cold seas, a pair feels warmer.
I open my mouth to show her.
Together we sink into the deep.
Her dorsal fin brushes mine.
This mouth cannot hold anything.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推那块木头。
lines.en: I nudge the plank with my snout.
It is small; I slide right over it.
I filtered in a few scraps.
A fish this big does not pick things up.
The iron sank and I let it.
Only water and krill stay in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你掉的箱子我顶了一下。
lines.en: I bumped the crate you dropped.
I do not swallow what I cannot eat.
My fin knocked it over.
Blood in the water, drifting under the ice.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼闯进我的水道。
lines.en: That big fish entered my lane.
I turn my head, slowly.
It darts about right at my mouth.
I do not like being followed.
It struck my gills.
This channel is mine alone.
That shadow is smaller, and dares come near?
The ripples break; something stirs.
Opening my mouth counts as a warning.
It keeps circling me.
My tail stops; I turn toward it.
Few things in the deep would touch me.
This time I will not give way.

lines.zh: 有东西在冰面上敲，声音传下来了。
lines.en: Something knocks on the ice; the sound reaches me.

lines.zh: 那只海豹从我嘴边游过，太近了。
lines.en: That seal swims past my mouth, too close.

lines.zh: 我闻到水变了味，有人搅浑了它。
lines.en: The water tastes wrong; someone muddied it.

lines.zh: 背鳍一紧，我把它当成猎物了。
lines.en: My fin stiffens; I have taken it for prey.
I fix on it and bear down slowly.
It slips into a crack in the ice.
My open mouth points right at it.
You step back, I advance ten paces.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，影子先压过去。
lines.en: I swim slowly; my shadow arrives first.
It is counting my tail beats.
I swing around the reef and follow.
In cold water I outlast it.
It tries to slip beneath me.
I turn broadside and block the way.
I follow the blood taste through the water.
No rush; it cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴滤水，你正好顺流而来。
lines.en: I cruise with my mouth open, and you drift right in.
There is nowhere for it to hide here.

lines.zh: 我先沉下去，再从下面看它。
lines.en: I sink first, then look at it from below.

lines.zh: 我明明比它大，它还不走。
lines.en: I am larger than it, and still it stays.

lines.zh: 我把水滤出一片空白，逼它往外。
lines.en: I clear a space in the water, pushing it out.

lines.zh: 它的影子在我嘴里穿过三次。
lines.en: Its shadow passes through my mouth three times.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的幅度越来越小。
lines.en: The sweep of my tail grows smaller and smaller.
I wait; the cold water watches for me.

lines.zh: 我整口吞下去，水都浑了。
lines.en: I gulp it down and the water clouds.
My jaws close around its middle.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一直张着，滤浮游。
lines.en: My mouth stays open to filter.
One shake of my head throws it clear.
My teeth are small, but they work.
It slams against my gums.
That bite takes half its life.

lines.zh: 滤网一样的嘴咬住就不放。
lines.en: My filter mouth clamps on and won't let go.
Blood spreads through the water.
I pin it against the reef.
It still tries to flee; I hold it down.
My mouth is full of broken scales.

lines.zh: 我张开的嘴，能吞下一整群。
lines.en: My open mouth can swallow a whole school.

lines.zh: 冷水把我这一口冻得发沉。
lines.en: The cold makes my bite heavy.
I appear deep in the frozen ocean.
Cold water surges; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我这么大，海却接住了我。
lines.en: Huge as I am, the sea holds me.
The dark water under the ice bears me up.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，海底的沙飞起。
lines.en: One tail beat lifts sand off the floor.

lines.zh: 我从深海的蓝里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep blue.
This cold water is mine now.
I open up and take my first mouthful.
There is someone on the ice; I see them.
I slowly patrol this patch of sea.
Forty hearts will last me a long while.
The deep temperate water is a bit salty.

lines.zh: 我背鳍划破平静的水面。
lines.en: My fin cuts the calm surface.
It is quiet here; I like it.

lines.zh: 我在深寒海的暗流里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the deep cold current.

lines.zh: 冻洋的浮冰下，我缓缓摆尾。
lines.en: Beneath the frozen ocean's ice, I sweep my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 这次只来了我一个，够占这片海。
lines.en: Only I came this time, enough to claim this sea.

lines.zh: 我嘴里先灌进一口冷水。
lines.en: A mouthful of cold water fills my mouth first.

lines.zh: 海床被我压出一小片平沙。
lines.en: The seabed is pressed into a patch of flat sand.

lines.zh: 我的影子从深水里慢慢升上来。
lines.en: My shadow rises slowly out of the deep.
The icy water scalds; I dive away.

lines.zh: 我被推到浅滩上，压得慌。
lines.en: I got shoved onto the shallows, pinned.
Out of the water I cannot live.
A blast underwater leaves my head ringing.
A harpoon sank into my fin.
Strange force clamps my gills shut.
Too long filtering; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我整个麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea and I went numb.

lines.zh: 我再大，也游不出这片黑。
lines.en: Big as I am, I cannot swim out of this black.
